blocks.text: After deployment, you can modify virtual branch devices.
To edit a virtual branch device:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Branch Connector > VM Group.
From the VM Group page, locate the group or the individual device you want to modify and click the Edit icon.
Group
In the Edit Virtual Branch Device window:
Software Upgrade Schedule: Designate a day and time for periodic software updates. To learn more, see Managing Cloud & Branch Connector Upgrades.
In the Tunnel Information section, configure the following:
ZIA Tunnel Mode: Select either Unencrypted or DTLS for the encryption type to be used when forwarding traffic to Internet & SaaS.

Fallback to TLS: You can only enable this feature if Unencrypted UDP or DTLS is selected as the ZIA Tunnel Mode. Select Enable to have the tunnel type automatically switch to TLS if the tunnel becomes unhealthy. Select Disable to deactivate this feature. This feature is enabled by default.
In the Location Information section, view the following:
Name: The name of the Branch Connector group.
Location Name: The location where your Branch Connector was deployed from.
No. of Connectors: The number of Branch Connectors belonging to the Branch Connector Group.
Connector Names: The names of the Branch Connectors.
See image.
Click Save and activate the change.
Individual device
In the Edit Virtual Branch Device window:
Status: Select Enable or Disable to activate or disable the device.
Last Heartbeat Received On: View the date and time the device last received a heartbeat.
Software Upgrade Schedule: Designate a day and time for periodic software updates. To learn more, see Managing Cloud & Branch Connector Upgrades. You can view the following information:
Last Upgrade On: The date and time when the software was last upgraded.
Current Version: The current version of the software.
Scheduled Version: The version of the software to update to.
ZIA Tunnel Mode: View the encryption type to be used when forwarding traffic to Internet & SaaS.

Fallback to TLS: You can only enable this feature if Unencrypted UDP or DTLS is selected as the ZIA Tunnel Mode. Select Enable to have the tunnel type automatically switch to TLS if the tunnel becomes unhealthy. Select Disable to deactivate this feature. This feature is enabled by default.
Location Information: View the following:
Name: The name of the Branch Connector group.
Location Name: The location where your Branch Connector was deployed from.
Connector VM Size: The size of the the Branch Connector VM.
Provisioning Template Name: The name of the branch configuration template.
Connector Information: View the following:
Management Outgoing Gateway IP Address: The default gateway IP address.
Management IP Address: The IP address of the Branch Connector.
Management DNS Server 1: The IP address of the primary DNS server.
Forwarding Information: View the following:
Internal Gateway IP Address: The gateway IP address.
DNS Server 1: The IP address of the primary DNS server.
Service Information: View the following:
Service IP: The service IP address.
Virtual IP Address: The virtual IP address.
Load Balancer: The load balancer IP address.
See image.
Click Save and activate the change.
